conclusions: Full fresh-start ingestion accepted every emitted Claude and Codex local-context row with zero failures.
Fresh-start load improved Claude from 2836.28s to 756.78s and Codex from 1692.52s to 419.74s.
Immediate first restart warms from the anchored checkpoint instead of replaying the full WAL tail.
Immediate first restart promoted Codex 80,496 cache entries in 14.70s and Claude 105,418 cache entries in 14.28s, both with zero memory evictions.
Duplicate coverage reruns skipped every row for both agents, proving the session coverage index maps the ingested rows.
The combined event+source-index command reduces raw-first durable WAL volume from three commands per source to two while preserving nodes, events, and source indexes.
Remaining bottleneck is fresh ingest/index growth and final shard-index serialization in large sessions.
